anomalies.observed: The LDO output REG3.1 is on net +3.3V, while the MCU VDD pins are on separate unconnected nets. The net +3V3 contains decoupling capacitors but no power source and no MCU VDD pins.
anomalies.expected: A single 3.3V rail should connect REG3.1 to all FCC2 and NAVC2 VDD pins, as specified: '3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs'.
